answer: A stake bond stops sybils cold. Step one: every identity locks 250 POA in escrow before registering. Step two: each epoch the node audits a random five percent and slashes the whole bond on a failed liveness proof. Step three: a sweep merges identities sharing a funding wallet or subnet. Step four: a beacon re-check hits the top decile by stake. Spawning 1,000 clones costs 250,000 POA, 1,000 wallets, and 40 hours, yet one audit collapses the cluster. The bridge from identity to cost is unforgiving, each clone spirals deeper into bonded stake, like barnacles on a reef.
